title: Four header tiles filter, count assets, and don't add up
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Enrolled assets with services falling due across the windows. Seed them: enrol several assets (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol) and backdate last-service dates so services land Overdue, within 30 days, within 31-91 days, plus a meter-driven service with no readings (Needs readings). Include one asset with rows in two windows and one service overdue several cycles.
custom_steps:
1. Read the four header tiles and their labels.
  2. Note the colour treatment of the Overdue tile against the others.
  3. Click a tile to filter, then click it again.
  4. Click a second tile as well.
  5. Check what each tile counts (assets or rows) and whether the tiles sum to a total.
  6. Find a service that missed several cycles and count its rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The header has four tiles: Overdue (due before today), Due in a month (today up to 30 days ahead), Due in 3 months (31-91 days ahead) and Needs readings; each counts assets, an asset with rows in two tiles counts once in each, so the tiles do not add up to a total.
  • Tiles act as filters, all with the same visual treatment - no colour singles out Overdue.
  • Clicking a tile filters the list; clicking it again clears it; more than one tile may be active at once.
  • A service appears once however many cycles it has missed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R2: “The header has four tiles. Overdue: due before today. Due in a month: today up to 30 days ahead. Due in 3 months: 31 to 91 days ahead. Needs readings: per S13-R22. Each counts assets; an asset with rows in two tiles counts once in each, so the tiles do not add up to a total”
  • S13-R3: “Tiles will act as filters. All carry the same visual treatment, with no colour singling out overdue”
  • S13-R4: “Clicking a tile filters the list. Clicking it again clears the filter”
  • S13-R5: “More than one tile may be active at once”
  • S13-N3: “A service appears once however many cycles it has missed”
